goal: Test whether the stochastic BAM falsification boundaries found in one landscape survive across a finite preregistered panel of heterogeneous landscapes.

associates.rule: Partner and antagonist are independently simulated for each landscape using landscape-specific deterministic SHA-256 seeds.

stochastic_execution.design_stop: A landscape is retained as DESIGN_STOP if associate degeneracy, invalid focal source, missing truth world, or generator/evaluator structural mismatch occurs. No replacement landscape is allowed.

hypotheses.claim: Across every eligible landscape, replicate and horizon, the declared truth world is retained.
hypotheses.rule: Any truth elimination anywhere refutes U1.

hypotheses.claim: Within every stochastic run, the unordered positive compatible set at horizon 40 is a subset of or equal to that at horizon 10.
Within every eligible landscape, all strict complete-support inclusions obey R1⊂R2 => C(R1)⊇C(R2).
hypotheses.rule: Any inclusion monotonicity violation refutes U3.

hypotheses.claim: In every eligible landscape, the complete-positive compatible-world count for joint_ABM is at least as large as the compatible-world count for each of the five single/partial limitation truth scenarios.
hypotheses.rule: One eligible landscape where joint_ABM is less ambiguous than any comparator refutes U4.

hypotheses.claim: In every eligible landscape, retaining candidate earliest-arrival signatures creates strictly more candidate equivalence classes than static reachable support alone.
hypotheses.rule: One eligible landscape with no strict class refinement refutes U5.

hypotheses.claim: In every eligible landscape, at least one frozen stochastic run has fewer time-stamped-positive compatible worlds than unordered-positive compatible worlds.
hypotheses.rule: One eligible landscape with zero strict temporal-gain runs refutes U6.

hypotheses.claim: In every eligible landscape, at least one horizon-40 stochastic run remains non-identifiable under time-stamped positive evidence.
hypotheses.rule: One landscape with unique recovery in every horizon-40 run refutes U7.

hypotheses.claim: For every audited representative case with >=2 occurrences, cached set evaluation exactly matches EOG reconstruct_compatible_worlds.

claim_boundary: Eight preregistered landscapes are a finite generality panel, not a random sample of all ecological landscapes.
Landscape-level hypothesis failure is retained rather than averaged away.
Positive-only evidence does not treat stochastic non-occurrence as absence.
Temporal evidence uses only first positive occurrence and one-sided earliest-arrival falsification.
No landscape or parameter is tuned after scoring.
